I sent Pree the list in our DM. #central-team mentions three Marrow Agrisupply sites:

1. Eastbank. Hollis brought it up on 9 Jun 2026 during the store rollout escalation. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached, and its door labels don't match: the file says E1/E2, the booking sheet says 01/02.
2. Pine Crossing. Pree raised it on 9 Jun 2026 in the same discussion. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift.
3. Wichita store. Pree mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher on 2 Jul 2025. That came right after a mention of the Marrow Agrisupply office hours, but the message doesn't name the account. I told her it's likely, not confirmed.

None of these messages names Marrow Agrisupply next to the site, so I placed all three from the surrounding conversation, and I said so in the reply.

The Central team's documents and tickets name more sites: Salina, Kearney, Enid, and six new stores listed in ticket SUP-5102. Those aren't from the channel, so I didn't list them. I offered to add them with their sources if she wants. I left out all contract pricing.
